## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Plant City, United States. It starts at 5145 Harvey Tew Rd.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Unfortunately time travel isn't a thing... yet. Until it is, those of a paleo persuasion are best served at Florida's Dinosaur World.
>
> Walk among 200 life-sized dinosaur models and uncover hands-on activities in a lush garden setting. You can also enjoy dinosaur-themed playgrounds, a Dino Gem Excavation and so much more!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €27.54. It was rated 4.7 out of 5 from 116 ratings and 66 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
